commands.title: ibcmd-rs: Reload Connections and Refresh Status

ibcmd.executable.description: Legacy executable override; ibcmd-rs.path takes precedence.

ibcmd.connections.description: Infobase IDs bound to this workspace folder.

ibcmd.connectionMetadata.description: Friendly names and authentication preferences; passwords belong in SecretStorage.

ibcmd.sourceDirectory.description: Source export folder relative to the selected workspace folder.

ibcmd.statusBaselineDirectory.description: Read-only reference export folder (last synchronization or a separate Git checkout). Without a baseline, change direction is unknown.

ibcmd.statusGitRef.description: Git commit/ref used as baseline (overrides baseline directory). Snapshot is pinned to a resolved Git tree.

ibcmd.statusCacheDirectory.description: Absolute cache directory for inspectable Git baseline snapshots. Required for Git comparison; snapshots are retained for Trash cleanup.

ibcmd.statusComparison.description: Native DB versions + local baseline bytes by default. Bytes is an explicit legacy preview, without native version parity.

ibcmd.statusTimeoutSeconds.description: Deadline per object-status read in seconds (30–3600). User cancellation remains available; other RPC timeouts are unchanged.

ibcmd-rs.path.description: Trusted executable override. Empty uses bundled binary, then ibcmd-rs on PATH. Never a shell command.
